footer.description: Your place for fishing adventures and relaxation close to nature. We welcome all fishing enthusiasts.

hero.title: Kozłowski Reservoir
hero.subtitle: Welcome to the information page of the private fishery Kozłowski Reservoir! Our beautiful lake, located in a picturesque area right next to Dębica, is a unique place for relaxation and fishing, home to carp, grass carp, and pike.

bento.title: Key Information
bento.subtitle: Everything you need to know before casting your line.
bento.hours_desc: Open from dawn to dusk. Night fishing is possible by prior telephone arrangement.
bento.nokill_desc: Strict catch and release policy. Every caught fish returns to the water.
bento.directions_desc: Easy access from Dębica (approx. 10 mins). Parking available right next to the lake.

characteristics.title: Fishery Features
characteristics.shoreline_desc: Wide and easy access to the water along the entire length of the reservoir. The shoreline has been carefully prepared, offering anglers comfortable conditions for both bait boat casting and shore casting, free from obstructing weeds.
characteristics.spots_desc: Natural, grassy, and well-maintained spots, regularly mowed and prepared for anglers. Each spot offers ample working space to pitch a carp bivvy, park a vehicle, and handle fishing gear comfortably.
characteristics.security_desc: Safety and peace of mind during multi-day sessions. The entire fishery area is fenced, and a modern 24/7 video monitoring system ensures full protection of your property and vehicles.
characteristics.card_subtitle: An ideal place for a weekend

pricing.title: Permit Pricing
pricing.desc: Fishing at the Kozłowski Reservoir requires buying a license. Payment strictly in cash on site to the host.
pricing.subtitle: Check the fees for fishing and relaxing by the water.

pricing.weekday_desc: Possible only by prior phone arrangement.
pricing.guests_desc: Prior contact and host's permission required.
pricing.no_hidden_fees_desc: We do not offer complex season passes, packages, or specific spot reservations. Our conditions are transparent: you arrive at the fishery, agree on the details on-site, and enjoy your fishing.

about.title: About the Fishery
about.subtitle: Kozłowski Reservoir is 100 ares of pure nature. Here silence meets adrenaline, and the angler comes face to face with a demanding opponent.
about.not_random: This is not a random number.
about.live_index_desc: Our system connects live to a weather API and analyzes 4 key factors affecting fish activity. The algorithm (based on solunar theory) calculates data in real time, giving you an edge on the water.
about.factor_pressure_desc: Stable, high pressure (1015+ hPa) stimulates fish to feed. Sudden drops "put them to sleep".
about.factor_moon_desc: Full and New Moon are peak activity moments (solunar theory). Fish feel the gravity.
about.factor_wind_desc: Light wind oxygenates the water and masks the angler's presence. Strong wind (>30km/h) makes fishing difficult.
about.factor_season_desc: Spring awakening (III-V) and autumn feeding (IX-X) are bonus points for the score.
about.card_nature_desc: Kozłowski Reservoir is a charming 100-are water body, surrounded by a picturesque wall of trees and natural vegetation. The silence, interrupted only by the rustle of reeds, birdsong, and spectacular fish splashes, creates a perfect enclave to escape from city noise, find peace, and deeply relax in the lap of nature.
about.card_trophy_desc: Thanks to regular and thoughtful stocking and strict compliance with the 'Catch and Release' (No Kill) policy, our lake has become a sanctuary for true specimens. Anglers can count on encountering huge, hard-fighting carp, grass carp with incredible runs of strength, and clever pike hunting along the reed beds.
about.card_security_desc: We care about the maximum comfort of our guests. The fishery area is completely fenced, lit, and monitored around the clock. We provide convenient access directly to the spots, secure parking in the closed area of the lake, and 24/7 assistance from the host in any situation.
about.spring_desc: Awakening. Crucian and Bream bite gently.
about.summer_desc: Peak season. Carp and Grass Carp fight hardest.
about.autumn_desc: Predator time. Pike feeds before winter.
about.winter_desc: Quiet on the water. Time for fishery recovery.
about.carp_tip_high: Conditions for carp are excellent. Optimal temperature and stable pressure stimulate fish to feed intensively.
about.carp_tip_low: Low water temperature or a sudden drop in pressure has weakened carp activity. Choose deeper spots and finer tackle.
about.carp_tip_mid: Moderate carp activity. Look for fish near fallen trees and weeds, bait sparsely and precisely.
about.predator_tip_high: Superb conditions for pike and zander. Stronger wind and cloud cover make it easier for predators to hunt by sight.
about.predator_tip_low: Clear skies and hot weather discourage predators. Try fishing in the early morning or at dusk in the shade of vegetation.
about.predator_tip_mid: Average conditions for pike. Use natural baits and actively search different depth zones.
about.general_tip_high: Great solunar and meteorological conditions for most fish species. Ideal time for a session.
about.general_tip_low: Unfavorable pressure or drastic temperature swings. Fish can bite very capriciously.
about.general_tip_mid: Typical conditions on the water. Success depends on choosing the right spot and choosing the correct bait.
